title: Fall Car Prep: 5 Quick Checks for Saskatoon Drivers
caption: As temperatures dip in Saskatoon, a few minutes of preventive care can keep you moving safely. Check tire pressure, test the battery, inspect brakes, top off fluids, and replace windshield wipers before the first frost.

title: Don’t Ignore the Check Engine Light
caption: A lit check engine light can signal anything from a loose gas cap to more serious engine or emissions issues. If you see it, schedule a diagnostic check as soon as possible to stay safe on Saskatoon roads.
image_prompt: Close‑up of a car dashboard with the check engine warning light glowing amber, the steering wheel slightly visible.
